newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-BTPs may slip to 137.45 but upside intact.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-BTPs may slip to 137.45 but upside intact.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE may back down a little, but only to resume their fast-forward run, targeting 138.68/88 in the near term, analysts said on Friday.
David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston said while the market hovered above the 137.75/65 area, where a small gap was left earlier this week, it would remain bullish.
"We are looking for a move back to 138.68/88 as our initial target, and in the bigger picture towards 140.00," said Sneddon.
By 0738 GMT, September BTPs were down 0.17 at 137.72.
